workflows.name: Block hash as Falcon IOC
workflows.description: Pushes a hash observable flagged as IOC in TheHive to CrowdStrike Falcon as a blocking indicator.

workflows.name: Contain host on critical case
workflows.description: Network-contains the affected Falcon host when a critical case is opened in TheHive and logs the action in the case timeline.

workflows.name: Slack Alert Manager
workflows.description: The Slack Alert Manager workflow automates alert monitoring and response tracking through Slack. It processes reactions, comments, and thread replies to update alert statuses, ensuring timely follow-ups and efficient incident management.
